I will apply inorganic fertilizer on this plot because the cooperative brought DAP and urea, and maize needs these nutrients to yield well. I will also spread cattle manure before ploughing, as we have done for many years to keep the soil fertile. I managed to get improved maize seed from the extension agent, so I will plant that rather than local seed. We do not use pesticides or irrigation here—we depend on the rains and remove weeds by hand—so my children and I will work this plot ourselves without hiring outsiders.
